previous_digest_file: 2026-10-10 - Weekly Portable Audio DSP GitHub Digest.md

top_repos.portability_reason: The reusable q_lib headers are separable from q_io audio-device, stream, and file code, but templates and memory behavior still need Cortex-M7 profiling.
top_repos.value_reason: Q's q_lib contributes reusable biquads, delay lines, envelopes, oscillators, and pitch utilities without requiring its q_io device layer.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with q_lib biquad, delay, envelope, and oscillator headers; replace q_io with fixed board callbacks and benchmark template size plus denormal behavior.
top_repos.note: Re-entry: updated - Q's q_lib contributes reusable biquads, delay lines, envelopes, oscillators, and pitch utilities without requiring its q_io device layer.
top_repos.summary: C++ Library for Audio Digital Signal Processing

top_repos.portability_reason: The header-only DSP layer is cleanly separated, but its four-lane math backend selects SSE4.1 or NEON with no Cortex-M7 scalar fallback and many processors own dynamic vectors.
top_repos.value_reason: Madronalib's mature MIT source/DSP layer combines vectorized filters, delays, generators, routing, resampling and approximation math behind one header-only include, separately from its RtAudio and VST examples.
top_repos.port_idea: Implement a four-lane scalar float backend for MLDSPMathSIMD, then extract one filter-plus-delay chain with fixed buffers; leave matrix, networking, dynamic graph and FFT support out of the first Cortex-M7 build.
top_repos.note: Returning - Madronalib's mature MIT source/DSP layer combines vectorized filters, delays, generators, routing, resampling and approximation math behind one header-only include, separately from its RtAudio and VST examples.
top_repos.summary: Madronalib: a C++ framework for DSP applications.

top_repos.portability_reason: The C++11 headers are host-independent, but delay and spectral classes own dynamic storage at setup; firmware should select small modules and replace those buffers with bounded caller-owned memory.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT C++11 headers combine fractional/multi-tap delay, cubic curves, envelope utilities, multirate helpers, FFT/STFT and spectral-processing primitives behind small independent includes.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with delay.h plus envelopes.h, provide caller-owned fixed storage for the delay, and defer FFT/spectral modules until SRAM and cycle budgets are measured.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT C++11 headers combine fractional/multi-tap delay, cubic curves, envelope utilities, multirate helpers, FFT/STFT and spectral-processing primitives behind small independent includes.
top_repos.summary: GitHub mirror of Signalsmith Audio's C++ DSP support library

top_repos.portability_reason: The crate has no_std, scalar and NEON implementations and preallocated processing buffers, but it still requires alloc/Vec/Arc and its NEON kernel targets AArch64 rather than Cortex-M7.
top_repos.value_reason: The dual-licensed Rust crate provides both a 16-64 sample-latency polyphase FIR and a mixed-radix FFT resampler, with f32 scalar and ARM NEON kernels plus explicit no_std support.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with the FIR path and scalar convolution, prebuild its 32-128 tap tables off the audio callback, replace alloc-owned buffers with a board arena, and benchmark the existing AArch64 NEON kernel only as an algorithm reference.
top_repos.note: Returning - The dual-licensed Rust crate provides both a 16-64 sample-latency polyphase FIR and a mixed-radix FFT resampler, with f32 scalar and ARM NEON kernels plus explicit no_std support.

top_repos.portability_reason: Useful scalar modules are host-independent, but the advertised no_std build retains unconditional std references and most delay, spectral and spatial processors depend on alloc-backed Vec storage.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT Rust port exposes Signalsmith-derived delays, filters, FFT/STFT, convolution, time stretching, phase rotation and room-spacing blocks in one library with generic f32-capable APIs.
top_repos.port_idea: Extract the delay and biquad modules first, replace Vec storage with fixed-capacity buffers, repair unconditional std constants/imports in the advertised no_std build, and defer STFT, convolution and time stretching until memory profiling passes.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT Rust port exposes Signalsmith-derived delays, filters, FFT/STFT, convolution, time stretching, phase rotation and room-spacing blocks in one library with generic f32-capable APIs.
top_repos.summary: A Rust library for audio and signal processing

top_repos.portability_reason: Individual header models keep allocation in prepare(), but C++20, dynamic setup storage, calibration work, and optional heavyweight processors require a deliberately small firmware subset.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT, header-only C++20 library exposes setup-thread-allocated tape, Koren triode/tone-stack, and Jiles-Atherton transformer models and ships an exceptions-free embedded profile.
top_repos.port_idea: Port one TransformerModel or TubePreamp block, preallocate its channel state, start at 1x oversampling, and leave convolution, phase-vocoder, and 64-grain processors out of the firmware build.
top_repos.note: Re-entry: updated - The MIT, header-only C++20 library exposes setup-thread-allocated tape, Koren triode/tone-stack, and Jiles-Atherton transformer models and ships an exceptions-free embedded profile.
top_repos.summary: Header-only C++20 audio DSP for real-time and offline processing. Filters, effects, analog circuit models, automatic dynamics, stereo tools, analysis and EBU R128 metering. Dependency-free DSP core with optional VST3, CLAP and Audio Unit adapters.

top_repos.portability_reason: Faust separates the DSP cleanly, but the generated four-voice pitch/delay engine reserves about 2.25 MiB of float delay storage, exceeding internal Daisy Seed and Teensy 4.x memory.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT Faust kernel creates four-voice automatic double tracking from independent delay, pitch and pan spreads plus wet filtering, with generated standalone C++ separated from its DPF plugin wrapper.
top_repos.port_idea: Regenerate a two-voice float kernel with much smaller pitch/delay maxima and fixed controls; the checked-in four-voice C++ reserves 589,824 floats (about 2.25 MiB) before other state, so it cannot use internal Daisy/Teensy RAM unchanged.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT Faust kernel creates four-voice automatic double tracking from independent delay, pitch and pan spreads plus wet filtering, with generated standalone C++ separated from its DPF plugin wrapper.
top_repos.summary: Automatic double tracking plugin (not only) for vocals

top_repos.portability_reason: tpt-dsp-core genuinely builds no_std with a stable scalar fallback, but the synth/effect crate still relies on std, Vec and Box, so only core primitives are direct and musical blocks need fixed-storage rewrites.
top_repos.value_reason: The dual-licensed Rust core provides no_std scalar filters, FFT/DCT/Hilbert, ring buffers and caller-buffer processing, while the adjacent audio crate supplies concrete FM, wavetable, subtractive, waveshaper, delay and EQ references.
top_repos.port_idea: Start with tpt-dsp-core --no-default-features and its scalar backend on thumbv7em; port one oscillator or waveshaper from tpt-dsp-audio to fixed arrays instead of bringing over its Vec/Box graph and convolution reverb.
top_repos.note: Returning - The dual-licensed Rust core provides no_std scalar filters, FFT/DCT/Hilbert, ring buffers and caller-buffer processing, while the adjacent audio crate supplies concrete FM, wavetable, subtractive, waveshaper, delay and EQ references.
top_repos.summary: Pure-Rust, real-time-safe DSP framework — zero-allocation audio/RF/control processing for desktop, WebAssembly, and no_std embedded targets. Dual-licensed MIT/Apache-2.0.

top_repos.portability_reason: Processing is scalar and host-independent, but channels, delay lines, oversamplers, matrices and some pointer helpers use dynamic vectors that must become bounded firmware storage.
top_repos.value_reason: JonssonicDSP's MIT header set exposes scalar TPT/SVF filters, waveshaping, oversampling, modulated delays and a configurable feedback-delay-network reverb with readable per-sample APIs.
top_repos.port_idea: Freeze one mono or stereo SVF-plus-FDN configuration, replace prepare-time std::vector storage and pointer-vector helpers with fixed arrays, and omit the FFT utility layer.
top_repos.note: Returning - JonssonicDSP's MIT header set exposes scalar TPT/SVF filters, waveshaping, oversampling, modulated delays and a configurable feedback-delay-network reverb with readable per-sample APIs.
top_repos.summary: A Modular Realtime C++ Audio DSP Library.

top_repos.portability_reason: Oscillator, ZDF filter, waveshaper and smoother have fixed processing state and zero runtime dependencies; only the vector-owned DelayLine needs caller-provided storage or omission.
top_repos.value_reason: The MIT C++17 modules provide PolyBLEP oscillators, a Cytomic/Zavalishin ZDF state-variable filter, third-order Lagrange fractional delay, a Buchla-style wavefolder, smoothing, and 61 host tests without runtime dependencies.
top_repos.port_idea: Port the oscillator, SVF, waveshaper, and smoother directly; give DelayLine a caller-owned fixed buffer before enabling it, and map atomic parameter setters to control-rate updates.
top_repos.note: Returning - The MIT C++17 modules provide PolyBLEP oscillators, a Cytomic/Zavalishin ZDF state-variable filter, third-order Lagrange fractional delay, a Buchla-style wavefolder, smoothing, and 61 host tests without runtime dependencies.
top_repos.summary: A high-performance, real-time C++ Digital Signal Processing (DSP) library designed for modular synthesis and low-latency audio applications.
